sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.1: Injectable: hold right click to inject. Needs cyberpsychosis. Restores 20 current Mind; each dose lasts its own 1 minute.
sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.2: Lowers cyberpsychosis by up to 40; when each dose ends you lose 5 Mind for good and part of the cyberpsychosis comes back. Hold sneak and hit another player to inject it into them. Using several in a row (within 3 minutes) makes it weaker.
sandevistan.mindzero: Your Mind hit 0%! It hurts (3 hearts), and using it now costs 2 hearts every 8 s of use while cyberpsychosis keeps building.

sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.2: With Good Mind, each second has a 1% chance to heal 1 Mind, and it lowers cyberpsychosis
sandevistan.immuno.used: Immunosuppressant: +%s current Mind and -%s cyberpsychosis for now.
sandevistan.immuno.end: A dose wore off: you lost %s Mind for good and %s cyberpsychosis came back.

sandevistan.implant.tip.3: Dodges 50% of attacks and projectiles, hits harder knockback, and eating, drinking and bows are faster.
sandevistan.implant.tip.4: Costs Mind (5 to turn on). Overuse causes cyberpsychosis.

sandevistan.vis.title: Visibility
sandevistan.rip.greet.crit.1: Your head is nearly empty, kid. Stop with the implants. Listen to me, this is no joke.
sandevistan.rip.greet.crit.2: I have seen people in this state. It ends badly. Rest and get treated before anything else.
sandevistan.rip.greet.low.1: Your mind is in tatters. I will not refuse you, but you need treatment.
sandevistan.rip.greet.low.2: Careful. Every point of Mind you lose does not come back easily. Take it easy.
sandevistan.rip.greet.load.1: Your body is at its Cyberware Load limit. A little more and your head cracks.
sandevistan.rip.greet.load.2: All that load will drive you mad. Think twice before putting more metal in you.
sandevistan.rip.greet.many.1: So much metal! You are turning into a machine part. Do not overdo it, kid.
sandevistan.rip.greet.many.2: I charge per implant, but even I think you already have too many.
sandevistan.rip.greet.mind.1: Your head is not as good as it used to be. A Stabilizer helps, you know?
sandevistan.rip.greet.mind.2: I have noticed some glitches in your mind. Do not ignore that.
sandevistan.rip.greet.psy.1: I can see the signs of cyberpsychosis in you. An Immunosuppressant fixes it, for now.
sandevistan.rip.greet.psy.2: Your head is restless. Breathe and watch what you do.
sandevistan.rip.sand.1: That Sandevistan on your back is beautiful, but it burns your head. Do not abuse it.
sandevistan.rip.greet.some.1: A implant or two suits you. How about one more? Fair price, of course.
sandevistan.rip.greet.some.2: You are adapting well. What will it be today?
sandevistan.rip.greet.none.1: Still flesh and bone, huh? I can fix that. What will it be?
sandevistan.rip.greet.none.2: Come in, make yourself at home. Here we improve on what nature made.
sandevistan.rip.after.ok.1: Done, it looks great. Take it easy the first few days.
sandevistan.rip.after.ok.2: Clean surgery. If it hurts, that is normal. Come back if you need anything.
sandevistan.rip.after.many.1: Done. But look, with so many implants you are playing with fire.
sandevistan.rip.after.many.2: One more for the collection. I warned you: the more metal, the less you.
sandevistan.rip.load.after.1: Done... but your Cyberware Load is past the safe limit. Do not blame me later.
sandevistan.rip.remove.1: Implant removed. Your body thanks you, and so does your mind.
sandevistan.rip.remove.2: Removed with no problems. Sometimes less is more.
sandevistan.rip.near.2: Watch your step. This place is for people who know what they want.
sandevistan.rip.near.3: If you want to talk, just come over. I do not bite... much.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.ram: Raises the Cyberware Load limit by %1$s%%: load psychosis only starts at %2$s%%. Adds no Load and only wears down while load is above 70%%.
